summary: Quantum Computing Inc. (QUBT) filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of NHanced Semiconductors, Inc. via a Stock Purchase Agreement. Aggregate consideration comprises $68.1M cash (subject to adjustments) plus ~$5.0M in QUBT stock, with $20.0M of the cash held in escrow contingent on NHanced's 2027-2028 revenue thresholds. Additional earnout of up to $72.0M based on revenue and EBITDA targets is payable in cash or stock. No price per share or premium was disclosed. The board recommended the transaction; advisors are not named. Watch for QUBT's dilution and integration risk; earnout mechanics and potential stock issuance create complexity.
